added.change: MP4 audio files are now supported.
Add a favicon using the Noto Color Emoji design of the bookmark emoji.
Add dark mode support.
Add `serve` subcommand: a perpetual self-hosted web app that persists ratings per-card, picks up file edits via inotify, and provides a review dashboard. Designed to run as a Docker container.
Implement `stats --format html` output.
Add `Dockerfile` and `examples/docker/` for self-hosting.
Dashboard now shows current day-streak, total reviews, and 30-day retention rate.

The Docker image now bundles `tzdata` and the example `docker-compose.yml` exposes a `TZ` environment variable. Set `TZ` to your IANA zone (e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`) so review timestamps and the dashboard heatmap match your wall clock.
Expand the self-hosting docs with a full Windows / Docker Desktop / WSL2 walkthrough, timezone setup, update procedure, LAN-access notes, and a troubleshooting section.

Add a "Reject" button to the drill UI (keyboard shortcut `r`) that flags the current card as low quality and permanently removes it from the review queue. Each rejection also appends a one-line entry to `<cards_dir>/rejected.log` containing the file path, the (1-indexed) line number, and a preview of the question — so you can find and edit the offending card offline. Editing the markdown changes the card's hash, which un-rejects it. To force-undo a rejection without editing, run `delete from rejected_cards where card_hash = '...'` against `hashcards.db`.

changed.change: Single newlines inside a card now render as line breaks instead of being collapsed to a space. Authors can write short lists of facts line-by-line without inserting blank lines or two-space hard-break markers.

removed.change: Remove `drill` subcommand. Use `serve` instead, which provides the same web UI as a long-running service.

fixed.change: Fix `serve` mode bug where clicking Reveal would render a different shuffled card with its answer instead of revealing the answer to the card the user was looking at. Reveal is now a purely client-side toggle — the answer and grade buttons are inlined in the page and unhidden by JavaScript, so there is no second GET to race against the shuffle.

added.change: Added installation instructions to the README.
Publish hashcards on `crates.io`.
Added support for Markdown tables and syntax highlighting of code blocks.
Added button tooltips.
Added a `--host` flag.
Start testing on macOS and Windows.

fixed.change: Fix a bug in the parser that broke TeX math in cloze deletions.
Added support for escaping square brackets in cloze deletions.
Fixed button visibility bug on iOS Safari.
Fix card content being invisible with Javascript disabled.

added.change: Added `--answer-controls` flag to the drill command with values "full" (default) or "binary". Binary shows only "Forgot" and "Good" buttons, mapping to FSRS Again and Good ratings.
Added a flag to turn off sibling burial.

fixed.change: Improved the look of blockquote elements.

added.change: KaTeX is now bundled with the executable, allowing hashcards to work entirely offline.

changed.change: Cards are shuffled randomly at the start of a session.

fixed.change: Fix a bug where the card cache was not cleared on undo. See [PR #57](https://github.com/eudoxia0/hashcards/pull/57).
Fix the initial flicker when rendering TeX math.

breaking.change: BREAKING: Media file paths are now deck-relative instead of collection-relative by default. Use the `@/` prefix for collection-relative paths.
BREAKING: Flashcards can no longer reference external URLs (e.g., `https://...`) in media file paths.

added.change: Deck files accept TOML frontmatter, so you can override the inferred deck name.
The session completed page shows a button to shut down the server.
Flashcards can be separated using `---` as an explicit separator.

changed.change: Killing the server with `ctrl+c` at the end of a session causes the server to die with exit code 0.
SQLite is once again bundled into the binary, increasing the executable size but reducing build problems especially on NixOS.

added.change: Add extra metadata to `Cargo.toml`.
Add `pre-commit.sh` hook.
The `macros.tex` file now supports comments: lines starting with `%` are ignored.
Add CSS to render `blockquote` elements in a grey box.
The `drill` and `check` commands now validate that images/audio files referenced in flashcards actually exist.

changed.change: The UI now works on small and mobile viewports.

fixed.change: Fixed a bug where exclamation marks broke the parsing of Cloze deletions. See [issue 29](https://github.com/eudoxia0/hashcards/issues/29).

added.change: Added `CHANGELOG.xml`.

changed.change: SQLite is no longer bundled into the binary, reducing the executable size.
